headword: {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}

definitions.gloss: balance certificate; proof of account balance
definitions.explanation: An official document issued by a bank that certifies the balance in an account at a specific point in time. Required for visa applications, loan applications, tax filings, and other official procedures.

examples.japanese: ビザの{申請|しんせい}に{残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A balance certificate is required for the visa application.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}で{残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}{書|しょ}を{発行|はっこう}してもらった。
examples.english: I had the bank issue a balance certificate.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}ビザの{申請|しんせい}には、{一定額|いっていがく}{以上|いじょう}の{残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}しなければならない。
examples.english: For a student visa application, you must submit a balance certificate showing at least a certain amount.

notes:
Composed of {残高|ざんだか} (balance/remaining amount) and {証明|しょうめい} (certification/proof). The full formal term is {残高証明書|ざんだかしょうめいしょ}, with {書|しょ} (document) appended. Particularly relevant for foreigners in Japan who need financial documentation for visa renewals and other immigration procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}{書|しょ}: balance certificate (full formal form)
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue a balance certificate
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a balance certificate
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to obtain a balance certificate

RELATED TERMS:
- {残高|ざんだか}: account balance — the amount of money in an account
- {通帳|つうちょう}: bankbook/passbook — another way to show balances
- {収入証明|しゅうにゅうしょうめい}: income certificate — a related financial document
